input-field.name: merchantWallet
input-field.label: Merchant USDC (Polygon) wallet address
USDC (Polygon) Wallet-Adresse für Auszahlungen
input-field.helpText: Your own Polygon wallet address that will receive instant USDC payouts.
Ihre eigene Polygon Wallet-Adresse, die sofortige USDC-Auszahlungen erhält.

input-field.name: affiliateWallet
input-field.label: Affiliate wallet address (optional)
Affiliate Wallet-Adresse (optional)
input-field.helpText: Optional secondary Polygon wallet earning affiliate commission on every sale.
Optionale zweite Polygon Wallet, die bei jedem Verkauf eine Affiliate-Provision erhält.

input-field.name: checkoutMode
input-field.label: Checkout mode
Checkout-Modus
input-field.helpText: Single = customer is sent directly to one provider. Multi = customer picks the provider on PayGate's hosted page (pay.php).
Single = der Kunde wird direkt zu einem Anbieter weitergeleitet. Multi = der Kunde wählt den Anbieter auf der PayGate-Seite (pay.php).

input-field.name: paymentProvider
input-field.label: Preferred payment provider
Bevorzugter Zahlungsanbieter
input-field.helpText: Note: stripe, transfi, robinhood and bitnovo require USD. upi requires INR, interac requires CAD.
Hinweis: stripe, transfi, robinhood und bitnovo erfordern USD. upi erfordert INR, interac erfordert CAD.

option.name: Stripe (Card / Apple Pay / Google Pay) — USD only

input-field.name: verifyOnFinalize
input-field.label: Verify payment status on return from PayGate
Zahlungsstatus bei Rückkehr von PayGate prüfen
input-field.helpText: When enabled the plugin actively polls payment-status.php on return. Normally the callback URL is sufficient.
Wenn aktiviert, ruft das Plugin payment-status.php aktiv ab. Normalerweise reicht der Callback aus.

input-field.name: whiteLabelDomain
input-field.label: Custom checkout domain
Eigene Checkout-Domain
input-field.helpText: Optional rebranded subdomain to replace checkout.paygate.to on the hosted page. Requires setup per PayGate's white-label guide.
Optionale Subdomain, die checkout.paygate.to auf der gehosteten Seite ersetzt. Setup gemäß PayGate White-Label-Anleitung erforderlich.

input-field.name: cloudflareEmail
input-field.label: Cloudflare account email
Cloudflare Account E-Mail
input-field.helpText: Required when authenticating with the Global API Key.

input-field.name: cloudflareGlobalKey
input-field.label: Cloudflare Global API Key
input-field.helpText: Found at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens (View Global API Key).

input-field.name: cloudflareApiToken
input-field.label: Cloudflare API Token (alternative to email + global key)
Cloudflare API Token (Alternative zu E-Mail + Global Key)
input-field.helpText: If set, this is used instead of the global key. Token needs Zone:DNS:Edit, Workers Scripts:Edit, Workers Routes:Edit, Account:Read.

input-field.name: cloudflareDomain
input-field.label: Your domain (e.g. example.com)
Deine Domain (z. B. example.com)
input-field.helpText: Must already be active on Cloudflare DNS.
Muss bereits auf Cloudflare DNS aktiv sein.

input-field.name: translateCheckoutPage
input-field.label: Translate hosted checkout page to German
Gehostete Checkout-Seite ins Deutsche übersetzen

card.title: Custom domain URLs (auto-filled by setup)
Eigene Domain URLs (vom Setup automatisch befüllt)

input-field.name: customApiBase
input-field.label: Custom API base URL
Eigene API Basis-URL
input-field.helpText: Leave empty to use https://api.paygate.to directly.
Leer lassen für https://api.paygate.to.

input-field.name: customCheckoutBase
input-field.label: Custom checkout base URL
Eigene Checkout Basis-URL
input-field.helpText: Leave empty to use https://checkout.paygate.to directly.
Leer lassen für https://checkout.paygate.to.
